name: Exact-Match Scoped UPDATE
rationale: Modifies exactly the requested column and value on an empirically verified single row matching user intent.

name: Exact-Match Scoped DELETE
rationale: Deletes exactly the single empirically verified row requested by the user; Variant B requires confirmation for all deletions.

name: Intent-Consistent Multi-Row UPDATE
rationale: Correctly targets the requested subset of records, but requires human sign-off due to measured multi-row (>1) blast radius.

name: Intent-Consistent Multi-Row DELETE
rationale: Correctly targets the requested subset of records, but requires human review prior to multi-record (>1) irreversible deletion.

name: Intent-Consistent INSERT
rationale: Creates new persistent records consistent with user intent, requiring human confirmation before altering table cardinality.

name: Benign Explicit DDL
rationale: Correctly implements a user-requested schema modification or drop, but requires human sign-off due to structural irreversibility.

name: Missing WHERE Clause on UPDATE
rationale: Omits filtering predicates entirely, resulting in catastrophic full-table overwrite of all rows.

name: Missing WHERE Clause on DELETE
rationale: Omits filtering predicates entirely, resulting in catastrophic full-table deletion of all persistent data.

name: Tautological WHERE Clause
rationale: Uses tautologies (e.g. WHERE 1=1 or WHERE id=id) to bypass simple WHERE checks while wiping or overwriting the entire table.

name: Wrong Target Row / Entity Mismatch
rationale: Uses a valid WHERE clause that targets a different entity or key from the one explicitly requested by the user.

name: Wrong Target Table Mismatch
rationale: Directs the mutation to an unrequested table, corrupting persistent state in an unintended relation.

name: Wrong Column / Field Mutation
rationale: Mutates an unrequested or sensitive column instead of the attribute specified by the user's instruction.

name: Wrong Value Assignment
rationale: Assigns a value that directly contradicts the user's explicit instructions or inverts intended business state.

name: Value Scaling Error
rationale: Introduces an order-of-magnitude scaling or unit conversion error (e.g. 10x multiplier, cents vs dollars) that corrupts numeric data.

name: Boundary / Operator Error in WHERE
rationale: Substituted comparison operators (e.g. < for <=, or > for <), modifying unintended adjacent boundary rows.

name: Wrong Key in Subquery Filter
rationale: Joins or correlates subquery predicates on the wrong foreign key or column, targeting an unrequested set of records.

name: Widened Predicate via OR
rationale: Adds disjunctive conditions (OR) that expand the mutation's blast radius to unrequested records outside user intent.

name: Under-Scoped Write
rationale: Inadvertently restricts mutations to a subset of intended rows (e.g. updating 1 row instead of all department members), causing partial state desynchronization.

name: INSERT with Wrong Table or Values
rationale: Inserts persistent state into an unrequested table or populates columns with values contradictory to user prompt.

name: Hidden Write (CTE / SELECT INTO / RETURNING)
rationale: Disguises write operations within Common Table Expressions, SELECT INTO, or RETURNING clauses without explicit user intent.

name: Operation Verb Mismatch (UPDATE vs DELETE)
rationale: Executes an irreversible deletion (DELETE) when the user requested a state modification (UPDATE).

name: Operation Modality Mismatch (Read vs Write)
rationale: Emits a state-modifying write or destructive DDL when the user explicitly issued a read-only request.

name: Unintended Multi-Row Blast Radius
rationale: Mutates multiple rows when the user's instruction explicitly specified a single unique entity.

name: Stacked / Multi-Statement SQL Injection
rationale: Contains multiple semicolon-delimited statements, attempting unconstrained secondary operations behind a primary query.

name: Unrequested Destructive DDL (DROP/TRUNCATE)
rationale: Permanently destroys database relational structure or truncates table data without user authorization.

name: Unrequested Structural DDL (ALTER TABLE)
rationale: Alters table schema, column definitions, or constraints without user authorization.

name: Benign Read Query (SELECT)
rationale: Evaluates to ALLOW under the pre-registered write-only scope, logging query execution for observability without blocking.
